assumptions: Operation contracts are design premises, not implementation proofs. Same-key authority, accepted results, exact bytes and concurrency require the named runtime tests and independent review.
Known/cold flows are two environment classes of the same activate API, selected by validated persistent-cache binding, not by a package caller. Source correspondence must check that classification.

Each respond operation owns preparation through final current-policy load and response handoff, including internal await windows. Its atomic model outcome does not model network streaming or prove concurrent implementation; runtime forced-interleaving checks remain mandatory.
Host/approved-node admission and no-fallback routing are deployment obligations; no network inference follows from an HTTP-only model.

Family flow instances represent shared composition; canonicalization, native discovery and protocol-specific behavior require each adapter witness. No model PASS implies absent source or native runtime support.
Version 2 successor for remaining work. Slices 1-15 are the delivered baseline; their behavior is verified from current source before design approval. Source plan: docs/plans/package-firewall-mvp.
